naslov: Partizan and Dubai stay unbeaten, Crvena Zvezda takes down Slovan
tekst:
By Eurohoops team / info@eurohoops.net
Partizan rallied from 14 points down to beat SC Derby 92–80 at Ranko Žeravica Sports Hall, improving to 6–0 in the ABA League. The visitors led 33–19 in the second quarter and held a 47–42 advantage at halftime.
Robert Franks converted a four-point play to bring Partizan within one in the third quarter, and Kyle Allman tied it at 64 heading into the fourth. Lamar Stevens and Nikola Tanasković helped the hosts open the final period with five straight points, and Partizan pulled away from there.
Franks led Partizan with 16 points, followed by Ethan Thompson with 13 and Antonio Reeves with 11. Tanasković added 10 points and a team-high performance index rating of 20, and all 11 Partizan players scored. Jyare Davis led Studentski Centar with 17 points and seven rebounds, while Aleksa Uskoković had 16 points and five rebounds.
Crvena Zvezda beat Slovan Bratislava 91–80 at Aleksandar Nikolić Hall in Round 7 of the ABA League.
Butler led Zvezda with 18 points, 12 of them in the third quarter, and added five assists and four rebounds without a turnover. Dobrić scored 13 points, David Krämer added 12, and Nick Weiler-Babb finished with six points and eight assists. Every Zvezda player who suited up scored.
Trevion Buchanan led Slovan with 18 points, while Zoran Nikolić added 15. Both teams made 13 three-pointers, with Zvezda shooting 13-for-30 and Slovan going 13-for-34. Zvezda next visit Real Madrid in the EuroLeague on Thursday.
Dubai beat Mega Superbet 98–87 in Round 7 of the ABA League, improving to 6–0. Mega won the fourth quarter 26–17 and dropped to 2–4.
Elie Okobo led Dubai with 18 points, followed by Davion Mintz with 16, Dwayne Bacon with 12 and Filip Petrušev with 11.
Petar Bačko scored 18 points for Mega, while Lukas Maniema added 17 points, six rebounds and five assists. Mihailo Bošković and Luka Paunov scored 13 apiece.
